prompt: A storm-sorcerer in crimson and ash-gray robes stands facing north on a windswept crag, arms raised as three distinct strands of red lightning twist from his fingers: one a single thick searing bolt, one a coiling whip of crackling energy wrapping his arm, one a scattered spray of small sparks. Wind whips his robes. The background is a churning dark thunderstorm sky over jagged peaks, lit only by the red lightning.

A single jagged bolt of crimson lightning lances down from a black thundercloud and strikes a soldier in dented steel plate armor on an open moor, the man thrown backward mid-collapse, armor sparking and scorched, arms flung wide. The background is a vast dark stormy sky with sheeting rain, the only light the violent red flash of the strike.

A wide low shot of three small forked bolts of red lightning raining down simultaneously across a battlefield, each striking a different armored warrior, the figures jolting and recoiling as sparks burst from their shoulders. The background is a war-torn field under a bruise-purple thunderstorm sky, smoke plumes drifting, lit by the scattered red flashes.

A snarling warrior in battered iron plate armor charging south-west, sword raised, his whole body wreathed in crackling red lightning and trailing red afterimages of speed, muscles surging with sudden frenzied power. The background is a chaotic battlefield under a dark electric storm, dust and embers streaking past, lit by the red energy coursing over him.

A close-up of a weathered bronze amulet shaped like a coiled thundercloud, held aloft in a gloved hand, three forks of red lightning arcing out of its central gem in different directions. The background is a dim stone chamber, the only source of light the red glow of the crackling charm.

A storm-witch in tattered wine-red robes hovering above a rain-lashed rampart, both hands cupped around a swelling orb of red electricity, hair and cloak streaming upward in the gale, an evil grin on her face as the storm answers her. The background is a towering black thunderhead split by red lightning over a besieged castle wall, lit by the orb.

Extreme close-up of two cupped hands conjuring a knot of forking red lightning between the palms, fingers splayed, sparks leaping to the fingertips, the Lichtenberg figures branching across the gap. The background is a blurred dark stormy night, the only light the searing red glow from the energy in the hands.

Worms-eye view from the ground looking straight up at a colossal red lightning bolt splitting the black sky and bearing down on the viewer, jagged Lichtenberg figures fracturing the clouds, rain falling toward the camera. The background is the underside of a roiling thunderstorm, lit blood-red by the descending strike.

Three separate jagged forks of red lightning striking down at once from a single black thundercloud across a wide horizon, each fork a distinct caret shape hitting a different rocky hilltop, branching Lichtenberg figures fanning out. The background is a vast crimson-tinged thunderstorm at dusk over barren highlands, dark clouds, vivid fantasy art.

A robed battlemage seen in side profile facing east, one arm thrust forward hurling a fat bolt of red lightning that branches into three forks as it leaves his hand, his sleeve smoking from the discharge, face lit harshly from below. The background is a ruined stone courtyard under a black storm, rain slanting, lit by the red flash of the spell.
